fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' fires an explosive shell in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and causes him to {{tip|dash|recoil}} 400 units in the opposite direction.
fields.description2: Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes in a cone to deal reduced damage to additional enemies.
